parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique token for each request. The **ClientToken** supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: IsTrial
parameters.description: Specifies whether the service instance is a trial instance.

parameters.name: ServiceInstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the service instance.

parameters.name: TemplateName
parameters.description: The name of the template. Specify this parameter if the service supports multiple templates.
